description: Index of the kits in this folder: for each kit its role, folder, system text, tool set, model tiers it was written for, and whether it has a shell.

defaults.KNOWLEDGE_LINE: 2. Read the aos knowledge base: aos/_description.json in the knowledge folder your brief names (index_view it for more, only when needed).
defaults.BOARD_LINE: BOARD: before you wait on someone, and when an answer is late, board_read them (who = their name, or "user" for the user's notice). A notice is information, not permission.
defaults.OWN_BOARD_LINE: OWN BOARD: when you stop to wait for someone, board_wait {"who": ..., "what": ...}; when the answer comes, board_wait {"who": ..., "done": true}.
